desc: The 1911 A1 Carry pistol features a 70 series internals, rotary hammer forged, chrome-plated barrel, and Novak 3-dot sights. It also has a Cerakote finish, hammer forged frame & slide, extended grip safety, and the slide release lever takes down hole chamfered. The pistol utilizes beveled mag well, undercut trigger housing, and flat main spring housing. Includes two 9-round mag and cleaning kit.
